statement: The combat sandbox can produce coherent server evidence from the same ability and companion policy used during interactive play.
test_method: Run four-bot victory and defeat profiles, validate captures, and compare final authoritative health against two clients after a disconnect handoff.
supporting_outcomes: Valid health transitions and real terminal outcome; two clients agree with server; disconnected investigator survives under bot control.
contradicting_outcomes: Contradictory damage, missing terminal events, divergent client health or lost investigator after disconnect.
